reason: 59 € a month is nothing next to what I pay my agency, which is exactly why I doubt it does the same job. I might poke at the free plan, but I won't pay for it or drop my freelancer until I see the output is as good as theirs.
objection: My agency knows my market and produces work I can approve on a Friday without rewriting it. I don't believe an AI co-worker fed a knowledge base gets that right, and I don't want to end up babysitting it myself.
would_change_my_mind: A month-long trial where it runs one real campaign and handles our support inbox side by side with my agency, with results I can compare directly.
